description: Implementation of AppNotifications, including subscription, emission, cleanup, and internal management of notifications and Thunder subscriptions within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing app notification handling, subscription management, and event dispatching.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation::SubscriberMap
classes.description: Manages subscribers for different events, including adding, removing, and dispatching notifications.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation::ThunderSubscriptionManager
classes.description: Handles Thunder-specific notification subscriptions and unsubscriptions.

methods.name: AppNotificationsImplementation::Subscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription requests for app notifications, managing internal maps and Thunder subscriptions.

methods.name: AppNotificationsImplementation::Emit
methods.description: Emits an event with payload to subscribers.

methods.name: AppNotificationsImplementation::Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up notifications associated with a specific connection and origin.

methods.name: AppNotificationsImplementation::Configure
methods.description: Configures the implementation with the provided shell interface.
